messages:
Priya Verma: Quick sync — aiming to roll API v0.14.0 + runtime v1.9.2 + Console v0.14.0 + SDKs tomorrow 11:00 PT. Need final PRs merged by EOD today. Posting a short checklist and rollback plan.
Ben Jansen: Is Console ready for the API change? Any breaking UI props we should know about?
Miguel Soto: runtime v1.9.2 includes the kv-cache proto change. Should be backward-compatible if SDKs pin to v0.14.0. I ran end-to-end on staging, saw one flaky eviction test. @Alice Kim can you confirm SDK publish timeline? :eyes:
Alice Kim: SDKs: branches are cut (main -> release). Waiting on CI (lint + changelog). If green I can tag and publish within ~2h.
Priya Verma: Cool. Minimal checklist to merge (order matters):
- merge API PR (#3124)
- merge runtime PR (#2107) if tests pass
- bump Console package.json -> v0.14.0 and merge
- tag & publish JS/py SDKs
Run this helper to validate: 
```
./scripts/release/checklist.sh --repos api,runtime,console,js-sdk,py-sdk
```
Ben Jansen: I'll run a quick smoke on Console after the package bump. Also flagging docs team to add a changelog blurb.
deploy-bot: CI summary: api: build ✅, runtime: tests ❌ (integration: kv-cache eviction), console: pending, js-sdk: build ✅, py-sdk: docs ❌ (docstring lint).
Miguel Soto: I'll take the runtime failing test — looks like a timing flake in cache eviction test. Re-running full suite now.
Alice Kim: py-sdk docs fail is a docstring lint; tiny fix inbound (1-line). Will push in ~10m.
Priya Verma: Plan A: if runtime tests pass in 30m we merge everything and proceed with scheduled window. Plan B: if runtime still failing, we defer runtime bump and proceed with API/Console/SDKs only, pinning runtime to v1.9.1 and releasing a hotfix branch next day. Approvals needed from @Ben Jansen and @Alice Kim to proceed under either plan. :shipit:
Ben Jansen: Approved for Console changes; will merge when green.
Alice Kim: Approved SDK changes; will tag & publish once py docs green.
Miguel Soto: Runtime re-run passed on second attempt — logs show the eviction timing fixed by small test tweak. All green now.
Priya Verma: Great — merging API now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/api/pull/3124 :thumbsup:
Ben Jansen: Console bump merged: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/489 — I updated the package json and minor style fix.
Alice Kim: js-sdk tag pushed v0.14.0: https://github.com/redwood-inference/js-sdk/releases/tag/v0.14.0. py-sdk publish queued once docs lint passes.
Priya Verma: Final ask — please add 1-2 sentence CHANGELOG entries on each PR before release window. I'll draft the release notes and post in #announcements once we cut the tags. Thanks everyone! :tada:
Miguel Soto: noted — runtime changelog updated in PR. Good work.
Priya Verma: (final) Release window set for tomorrow 11:00 PT — I'll publish the runbook 30m before and open the channel for cutover comms.
